async function onCreateNodeExtraBabel(
  content,
  {
    node,
    loadNodeContent,
    actions,
    createNodeId,
    getNode,
    getNodes,
    getNodesByType,
    reporter,
    cache,
    pathPrefix,
    ...helpers
  },
  options
) {
  const { createNode, createParentChildLink } = actions

  const mdxNode = await createMdxNodeExtraBabel({
    id: createNodeId(`${node.id} >>> Mdx`),
    node,
    content,
  })

  createNode(mdxNode)
  createParentChildLink({ parent: node, child: mdxNode })

  const { scopeImports, scopeIdentifiers } = await findImports({
    node: mdxNode,
    getNode,
    getNodes,
    getNodesByType,
    reporter,
    cache,
    pathPrefix,
    options,
    loadNodeContent,
    actions,
    createNodeId,
    ...helpers,
  })

  await cacheScope({
    cache,
    scopeIdentifiers,
    scopeImports,
    createContentDigest: contentDigest,
    parentNode: node,
  })
}
